reason: The Pinduoduo Open Platform docs are now readable (article API behind https://open.pinduoduo.com/application/document/browse?idStr=8EC06C399636041E 'API调用详解', 2026-09-25): POST https://gw-api.pinduoduo.com/api/router with type, client_id, timestamp (s), access_token and sign = UPPER(MD5(client_secret + sorted k/v + client_secret)). But the platform is SELLER-side (商家 authorization; 商品管理, 订单查询, 电子面单, 物流发货 for the merchant's own shop) with no API for buying from Pinduoduo, so this category's supplier catalogue, shipping quote and create_order have no counterpart; an adapter belongs with the sales channels.
